players.product: Large-scale liquid-cooled AI data-center campuses (Polaris Forge / Delta Forge)

quarterly_data.signal: As of May 31, 2026 Applied Digital had executed long-term leases for approximately 1,410 MW of contracted critical IT load across five campuses, representing approximately $36.2 billion of total contracted revenue over the initial 15-year base lease terms; each lease is a direct agreement with CoreWeave or an investment-grade hyperscaler, structured on a take-or-pay basis and non-cancellable, so a termination for convenience would require payment of the full remaining contractual value. The portfolio table lists Polaris Forge 2 (investment-grade hyperscaler) at 200 MW and ~$5.0B with expected delivery 2H26-1H27, and expected delivery of 2H27-2H28 for Polaris Forge 3, 1H27-1H28 for Delta Forge 1 and 1H28 for Delta Forge 2 (each with a high investment-grade hyperscaler).
quarterly_data.figure: 1,410 MW / ~$36.2B contracted (as of May 31, 2026); Polaris Forge 2 200 MW ~$5.0B (delivery 2H26-1H27); expected delivery Polaris Forge 3 2H27-2H28, Delta Forge 1 1H27-1H28, Delta Forge 2 1H28

quarterly_data.signal: Applied Digital says its standardized AI factory design lets it consolidate purchasing around a common set of qualified partners - including ABB for electrical equipment, BASX for mechanical and cooling systems, and Caterpillar for backup generation - and place bulk orders against a multi-gigawatt development pipeline; with prefabricated skids, modular construction and early procurement of long-lead equipment this supports build cycles of approximately 12 to 18 months per 100 to 150 MW facility.
quarterly_data.figure: build cycles of approximately 12 to 18 months per 100 to 150 MW facility

connects_to.relationship: Polaris Forge 1 — 400 MW dedicated AI data-center campus leased to CoreWeave (North Dakota)

contracts.signal: Applied Digital's contracted HPC lease portfolio table lists Polaris Forge 1 with anchor tenant CoreWeave: 400 MW of contracted critical IT load, a 15-year lease term, ~$11.0B of total contracted revenue and expected delivery 2H25-1H27. The CoreWeave leases (Building 2 and Building 3 signed May 28, 2025; Building 4 signed August 28, 2025) are take-or-pay and non-cancellable, with Applied Digital guaranteeing its subsidiaries' obligations.
contracts.units: 400 MW of contracted critical IT load; 15-year lease term
